rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 3-4 and Table 4 report the authors' own prototype (NodeMCU/Arduino sensor network, ThingSpeak cloud) and their own dataset of 3,000 sensor records used to train and test KNN, NB, RF, SVM and LR classifiers for pump on/off decisions.
rows.notes: The study builds an IoT/ML automated sprinkler irrigation prototype that switches a pump based on soil moisture, temperature and humidity thresholds; it reports classifier accuracy for the pump decision. It contains no remote sensing (satellite/UAV/imagery), no AgroBots, and no result on soil management, crop health monitoring, disease detection, weed control or pest control. The technology and function in the passage are not tested; only ground IoT sensors and ML for irrigation scheduling are evaluated. Disease prediction and cameras for plant monitoring appear only as literature discussion or future work.

notes: Full text appears complete. Minor internal inconsistencies in reported accuracies (Table 4 vs text) do not affect the rating since the claim is not addressed by the study.
